name: Conrad Tulum Riviera Maya
positioning: Oceanfront resort on the Riviera Maya, the more intimate, higher-end property within a larger Hilton complex, with a spa built from local rock and timber
best_for: Travelers who want a beach resort with easy reach of ruins and cenotes
Spa lovers interested in Mayan treatments

facts.text: The resort is an oceanfront hideaway overlooking the white-sand beaches of the Riviera Maya, off the beaten path.
The resort is about 30 minutes from Tulum.
Ancient ruins, natural wonders and other Riviera Maya attractions are within a half-hour's drive.
There are cenotes and hiking trails in the area, and the hotel can help guests access them.
The Conrad is the more intimate, higher-end property within a larger Hilton complex on the coast.
The franchise rights were sold to a Mexican couple, which may explain the resort's mix of brand amenities and local touches.
Rooms have large white beds, hand-painted artworks that echo the colors outside, and rattan chandeliers.
The spa has treatment casitas and offers a four-hands traditional Mayan massage.
The team is made up of local workers at all levels of the business.
There are nine places to eat.
Autor is the resort's fine Mexican dining venue.
Self-parking and valet parking are available for guests with vehicles.

highlights.text: The spa's central lounge is designed like a cenote, with sunlight coming through a large opening in the dome.
Ocean-facing rooms have hot tubs built into the balconies.
Wooden entrance doors pivot open onto a breezy lobby with a layered water view: ornamental pools, then the main central pool, then the Caribbean Sea.
The spa is built from local natural rock and timber.
Rooms are spread across three blocks, each with its own central pool with a pool bar and full service.

considerations.text: Reaching the main pool involves the lobby steps, which is less convenient with a stroller; there are lower-level rooms with accessible showers.
The resort is about 30 minutes from Tulum, and Tulum International Airport is about 65 km (40.6 miles) away.
The Conrad is part of a larger Hilton complex on the coast rather than a standalone property.
